name: playwright
description: Browser automation powered by the official Microsoft Playwright MCP server — navigate, click, type, fill forms, scrape, mock network, and inspect accessibility trees in Chromium, Firefox, WebKit, Chrome, or Edge.

interface.shortDescription: Drive any browser with the Microsoft Playwright MCP server.
interface.longDescription: The Playwright skill exposes the official @playwright/mcp server as a single Fractal toolset. It uses Playwright's accessibility tree (not pixel screenshots) so it works with text-only models and produces deterministic, structured browser interactions. Drives Chromium, Firefox, WebKit, or installed Chrome / Edge. Ships with the devtools, network, storage, and config capability groups enabled out of the box; add `vision`, `pdf`, or `testing` to the toolset args to enable coordinate-based mouse interaction, PDF export, or test-style assertions. Replaces the previous `browser` skill.
defaultPrompt: Use the Playwright skill whenever the task involves navigating, clicking, filling forms, scraping, or inspecting any web page.
Prefer `browser_snapshot` over `browser_take_screenshot` — the accessibility snapshot gives stable element refs you can act on.
Mock APIs with `browser_route` (network capability) instead of recompiling the app under test.
